purpose: Six complete current English guides reviewed for stronger factual ASC description; research only.
readScope: All six complete objects extracted from current modules and read including FAQs/practical/source/related fields. Initial combined output truncated two weather objects; both were recovered and fully read separately. No reliance on title/slug alone.

sources.label: Apple: set up iCloud Calendar on your devices
Microsoft: Outlook calendar API and supported mailbox data

evidence.supportedDescriptionLine: See work and personal plans together. View selected iCloud and Google calendars, with Microsoft calendars available in Premium.
evidence.useCase: Compare a family appointment, client call and work meeting without switching calendar views.
essentialBounds: iCloud calendars require device setup/calendar access; Google/Microsoft sign-in and provider permissions apply.
Combined view is not automatic busy masking or a merge; device calendar copies can be created.

sources.label: Google: importing events and its limitations
Microsoft: importing versus subscribing to a calendar

evidence.supportedDescriptionLine: Share one event without sharing the whole calendar. Send an email or QR invitation, or offer an App Clip preview.
evidence.useCase: Send dinner details or give a co-organizer access to a specific event.
essentialBounds: App Clip previews; full app needed for adding.
Synchronized sharing requires sign-in; Writer/Owner require appropriate identity.
Updates are not immediate delivery guarantees; no attendance RSVP or erased-copy promise.

sources.label: Apple: WeatherKit forecast information and regional availability
Met Office: forecast place, periods and weather values

evidence.supportedDescriptionLine: Plan with calendar and weather together on iPhone and iPad. Check Apple WeatherKit forecasts for your current or selected place.
evidence.useCase: Compare an outdoor appointment with the forecast for the place and hours that matter.
essentialBounds: Available forecast dates/hours and regional products vary; omit blanket10/14day guarantee.

sources.label: Apple: WeatherKit forecasts and regional availability

evidence.supportedDescriptionLine: Turn a forecast hour into an event draft, then review the time and destination calendar before saving.
evidence.useCase: Choose a possible outdoor appointment time from available hourly weather, then create the intended calendar entry.
essentialBounds: Draft action, not automatic save/booking/permission grant.
Do not market a dedicated full forecast embedded in every event; current guide explicitly declines that promise.

sources.label: Apple: Add and edit widgets on iPhone
Apple: Keeping a widget up to date
Apple: Add, edit, and remove widgets on iPad

evidence.supportedDescriptionLine: Keep upcoming timed appointments on your Home Screen with medium and large event-list widgets, or choose a date-and-weather layout.
evidence.useCase: Check the next eligible appointment at a glance; use the larger list for more upcoming rows.
essentialBounds: Selected calendars and future timed entries; all-day/ongoing excluded.
Finite rows, not complete day/week or all commitments.
No instant refresh, Lock Screen widget or universal device synchronization claim.

sources.label: Apple: month, multiple-day and list views in Apple Calendar
Teamup: view choices and browser versus mobile settings
Apple: week start, week numbers and alternate calendar display

evidence.supportedDescriptionLine: Compare start times, durations and overlaps in the week view. Scroll day columns and open event details when you need a closer look.
evidence.useCase: Review work and family commitments across days; keep all-day plans separate from hourly blocks.
essentialBounds: Drag/resize subject to rights and recurrence scope; no participant acceptance guarantee.
Week numbers, custom numbering and alternate-calendar overlays in article belong to Apple/Fantastical instructions, not Cloud feature promises.

suggestedOpening: Bring work, personal plans and weather into one calendar on iPhone and iPad. Compare selected calendars, check the forecast for your plans, and keep upcoming appointments on your Home Screen.
suggestedFeatureOrder: Selected iCloud/Google calendar overview; Premium Microsoft distinction.
Weather by selected place and available hours, including forecast-hour event draft.
Single-event sharing with separate email/QR/App Clip preview routes.
Home Screen event lists versus date/weather layouts.
Week view, details and permitted editing.
Clear Base/Advanced/Premium terms and sign-in boundaries.
shortPlanLine: Start with Base for Google calendar features, weather and widgets. Advanced removes ads; Premium adds Microsoft Calendar and Teams. Local calendars can be used without an app account; provider connections and sharing have their own sign-in and permission requirements.
linkRecommendation: Use the actual article routes above as optional learn-more links for concrete tasks, not as substitutes for explaining the features in the description. Avoid describing provider setup guidance as Cloud controls.
sourceTruthLimits: These are source-aligned product statements from audited articles; no new runtime test or binary correspondence proof.
Latest immutable native privacy evidence remains research/batch41-release/native-privacy-delta.json; source/API/privacy readiness remain separately assessed.
Do not import unsupported editorial claims of uniqueness, universal synchronization, private-by-default/no-data-collection or guaranteed delivery.
noMutations: Only this research JSON; no source or API writes.
